summary: The implementation covers all six core requirements well. REQ-1 through REQ-6 are all addressed: a procedurally generated 3D voxel world with React Three Fiber, a blocky blue bird character with third-person camera, WASD/Space movement with gravity and wing animation, block collision detection, an on-screen HUD with controls and coordinates, and a Minecraft-styled title screen with pixel font. A few minor acceptance criteria have gaps worth noting.

missing_requirements.requirement: The bird cannot fly through tree trunks or leaf blocks (horizontal collision with solid blocks)
missing_requirements.reason: The collision system in collision.ts only implements vertical ground landing via getGroundY which searches downward for the highest block below the bird. There is no horizontal collision resolution preventing the bird from passing through tree trunks or leaf blocks sideways. REQ-4 AC explicitly states the bird cannot fly through tree trunks or leaf blocks.

missing_requirements.requirement: Sun visible as a renderable object in the sky
missing_requirements.reason: REQ-1 AC requires a sky with sun. SkyScene.tsx provides a DirectionalLight positioned to simulate a sun but there is no visible sun mesh or sphere rendered in the sky. The sun as a visible geometric object is absent.
